project.name: NYC Taxi (sample)
project.description: Sample project: NYC Yellow Taxi trips for January 2025 through the generic jobs (Bronze -> Silver -> Gold -> fare model).

pipelines.name: taxi
pipelines.description: Silver (the quality rules on trips), the four Gold tables, then a fare model.

params.sql: SELECT CAST(tpep_pickup_datetime AS DATE) AS pickup_date, COUNT(*) AS trip_count, SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue, SUM(fare_amount) AS total_fare, SUM(tip_amount) AS total_tips, AVG(fare_amount) AS avg_fare FROM trips_clean WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < DATE '2025-02-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT hour(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS pickup_hour, COUNT(*) AS trip_count, AVG(fare_amount) AS avg_fare, AVG(trip_distance) AS avg_trip_distance, AVG(passenger_count) AS avg_passenger_count FROM trips_clean WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < DATE '2025-02-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT t.PULocationID, z.Borough AS borough, z.Zone AS zone, COUNT(*) AS trip_count, SUM(t.total_amount) AS total_revenue, AVG(t.fare_amount) AS avg_fare, AVG(t.trip_distance) AS avg_trip_distance, AVG(t.tip_amount) AS avg_tip FROM trips_clean t LEFT JOIN zones z ON z.LocationID = t.PULocationID GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY trip_count DESC

SELECT CAST(tpep_pickup_datetime AS DATE) AS pickup_date, COUNT(*) AS trip_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(congestion_surcharge, 0) > 0) AS trips_with_congestion, SUM(congestion_surcharge) AS total_congestion_surcharge, 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(congestion_surcharge, 0) > 0) / COUNT(*) AS congestion_trip_pct FROM trips_clean WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < DATE '2025-02-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT trip_distance, PULocationID, DOLocationID, passenger_count, hour(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS pickup_hour, fare_amount FROM trips_clean WHERE fare_amount BETWEEN 0 AND 500

queries.name: total_revenue
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(total_revenue) AS revenue FROM daily_revenue

queries.name: total_trips
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(trip_count) AS trips FROM daily_revenue

queries.name: daily_revenue_trend
queries.sql: SELECT strftime(pickup_date, '%b %d') AS day, total_revenue FROM daily_revenue ORDER BY pickup_date

queries.name: daily_trip_volume
queries.sql: SELECT strftime(pickup_date, '%b %d') AS day, trip_count FROM daily_revenue ORDER BY pickup_date

queries.name: demand_by_hour
queries.sql: SELECT pickup_hour AS hour, trip_count FROM hourly_demand ORDER BY pickup_hour

queries.name: avg_fare_by_hour
queries.sql: SELECT pickup_hour AS hour, round(avg_fare, 2) AS avg_fare FROM hourly_demand ORDER BY pickup_hour

queries.name: congestion_share
queries.sql: SELECT strftime(pickup_date, '%b %d') AS day, round(congestion_trip_pct, 1) AS pct FROM congestion_metrics ORDER BY pickup_date

queries.name: top_zones
queries.sql: SELECT coalesce(zone, 'Zone ' || PULocationID) AS zone, trip_count FROM zone_stats ORDER BY trip_count DESC LIMIT 10
